-- GPIO bridge: only native fresh-start/reset entry, no debug checkpoints.
function gw_control()
 local cmd=peek(0x5fff)
 if cmd==0 then return end
 poke(0x5fff,0)
 if cmd==2 then _init() end
 if cmd==2 or (cmd==1 and G_room.index==29) then
  sfx(0)
  G_player.x,G_player.y,G_player.is_hidden=432,446,false
  G_dark=30
  Map_update()
 end
end
function gw_publish()
 local bank=G_rooms[20]
 G_gw_flower=G_gw_flower or G_player.flower or G_win
 poke(0x5f80,246,G_room.index,#G_player.birds,#bank.birds,
  G_gw_flower and 1 or 0,G_win and 1 or 0,
  bank.secret_found and 1 or 0,G_player.has_bow and 1 or 0,
  G_player.state or 0,G_player.sprt.key,bank.is_solved and 1 or 0,
  (G_dark or 0)<=0 and not G_player.is_hidden and 1 or 0)
 poke2(0x5f8c,G_player.x,G_player.y)
 poke(0x5f90,G_gw_epoch,G_player.flower and 1 or 0,G_gw_note)
 poke2(0x5f93,G_gw_barks,G_gw_songs)
end
